topic: Your degree alone won't get you the internship: five things will, started in first year (re-upload in the new style)

cover.concept: A crowd where one stands out: an aerial view of a college convocation, a sea of identical grey gowns and caps, and one student in a lime jacket walking the other way with a laptop under one arm.
hooks: Five things. Not in your syllabus. (anger at the system)
cover.hookDraft: Five things. Not in your syllabus.
cover.lineDraft: Start them in first year, not final year.

slides.label: Thing 1
slides.idea: Learn the code, then direct the AI: small changes, give it the code and constraints, read every change it makes
slides.screen: A code editor with an AI chat side panel: a short prompt with the file and a constraint, and a diff with red/green lines the student is reviewing (Accept / Reject buttons)

slides.label: Thing 2
slides.idea: Solve problems you haven't seen: break it into parts, compare two approaches, explain why yours fits

slides.label: Thing 3
slides.idea: Build projects you can explain: trace one request from the page to the API to the database
slides.screen: Browser DevTools Network tab cropped to one request: POST /api/expenses, status 201, the request payload and the JSON response

slides.label: Thing 4
slides.idea: Your college isn't your only network: hackathons, open source, GSoC

slides.label: Thing 5
slides.idea: Prepare for the format they use: check if AI is allowed, then practise that way
slides.screen: An online assessment instructions page cropped to the rules box: duration, number of questions, and a line 'AI tools: not allowed' highlighted (fictional company, example.com)

slides.idea: Send this to a friend who is waiting for final year.

images.name: cover
images.prompt: Photoreal aerial photograph, magazine-ad quality, soft overcast daylight, subtle film grain. Looking straight down on a college convocation lawn: a dense, orderly crowd of graduates in identical grey gowns and grey mortarboard caps, all facing the same way, seen only from above. In the lower-middle of the frame one student in a bright lime-green jacket walks the opposite way through the crowd, a closed laptop under one arm. The top 35% of the frame is plain green lawn with nobody on it. Portrait 2:3, natural colours, not tinted. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no faces, no watermark.

images.prompt: Photoreal close-up photograph, magazine-ad quality, the same soft overcast campus daylight, subtle film grain. An open spiral notebook on a pale wooden campus bench, one page split down the middle with two hand-drawn diagrams of boxes and arrows side by side, one of them circled; a hand holding a pencil rests at the edge of the page; a closed laptop beside it. All of it sits in the lower half of the frame on a seamless warm cream paper (#f1f0d9) backdrop. The top 45% of the frame is empty, plain warm cream paper (#f1f0d9) backdrop with nothing in it. Portrait 2:3, natural colours. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no faces, no watermark.

images.prompt: Photoreal photograph, magazine-ad quality, the same soft daylight through tall windows of a college hall, subtle film grain. Seen from above at an angle: a long hackathon table shared by several students, only their hands and forearms visible, three open laptops, a tangle of chargers, sticky notes with doodled arrows, paper cups and a shared box of snacks. The table fills the lower half of the frame against a deep forest-green (#14261c) wall. The top 45% of the frame is empty, plain deep forest-green (#14261c) wall with nothing in it. Portrait 2:3, natural colours. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no faces, no watermark.
